messages:
Priya: Quick poll for the potluck tomorrow: if an LLM had to pick one dish to represent its persona, what would it bring? :stew:

Eli: It would bring perfectly portioned Bento boxes with a README.md for allergens. :bento:

Connor: Honestly a giant jar of guac with a changelog. "v1.2: added cilantro." :avocado:

Ava: It would label everything with intents: "salsa: snack.intent=share, confidence=0.92" and provide a 2-line serving suggestion. :taco:

Priya: Also imagine the LLM trying to upvote snacks by likelihood score and suggesting alternative snack prompts: "If you like spicy, try: "Add sriracha & lime.""

Eli: It would offer a short apologetic message when someone takes the last cookie: "Sorry, I incorrectly inferred remaining_count=0. Offering replacement options: 1) bake 2) buy 3) share credits." :cookie:
